title: Flatpack form composition
description: Contract for `form.yaml` (JSON-decoded). Defines form layout, action payloads, and field unions used by normalization and UI rendering.

model.description: Fully qualified Eloquent model class name.

icon.description: Lucide icon name for navigation and headers.

fields.description: Top-level field map. Fields only defined here render above tabs when tabs are present.

tabs.description: Tab panel map keyed by tab id. Tab fields merge with root fields into one values payload.

sidebar.description: Secondary column: extra fields and/or widgets. Inline map of field definitions, explicit `{ fields, widgets }`, or a relative YAML fragment path under the entity directory.

oneOf.description: Relative path to a YAML file (e.g. sidebar.yaml) beside form.yaml.

fields.description: Sidebar-only fields merged into the main values payload.

widgets.description: Dashboard-style widgets rendered in the sidebar column.

oneOf.description: Shorthand: map of field id → field definition (fields only).

actions.description: Top-level form actions map keyed by action id.

formActionsBlock.description: Named form actions map keyed by action id.

formTabPanel.description: Form tab panel definition with label, optional icon, and field map.

primary.description: When true, this action is the default for implicit form submit (Enter / primary CTA). If multiple are primary, the first in YAML order wins.

submit.description: When true, clicking this action submits current form values to the form submit endpoint. When false or omitted, it runs as a record action without posting form values.

headerActionDefinition.description: Header action definition for form pages. Requires exactly one of `action` or `href`.

buttonVariant.description: Supported button style variants. `primary` is accepted and normalized to `default` in UI code.

oneOf.description: Alias for list (redirect to entity index after success).

successRedirect.description: Post-action redirect target keyword, or `true` as alias for `list`.

actionInactiveUntil.description: Action gating definition that disables actions until predicates pass.

value.description: Compared with deep equality to the live form value for that field.

actionInactivePredicate.description: Single predicate used by `enabled_if` or `visible_if` gating rules.

yamlFormFieldType.description: Raw YAML field types before normalization. `date` is normalized to `date-picker`.

toolbarFieldAlign.description: Toolbar row alignment on the main axis. spaced uses equal space between items (flex justify-between).

repeaterDisplayMode.description: accordion uses collapsible rows; builder uses an alternate stacked editing layout.

repeaterFieldsYamlPath.description: Relative path to a YAML fragment under the entity composition directory that defines repeater item fields (resolved when loading compositions).

repeaterGroupDefinition.description: One selectable template group when the repeater runs in group mode.

key.description: Stable id written to each item (see `groupKeyFrom`). If omitted, the map key may be used when `groups` is an object.

icon.description: Optional Lucide icon name for the group picker.

repeaterInlineFieldsMap.description: Per-item field definitions inlined on the repeater. Mutually exclusive with `form` (path string).

repeaterGroupsReferenceOrInline.description: Group definitions as a path, ordered list, or keyed map.

oneOf.description: Path to a YAML file defining groups (array or map of group definitions).

selectOption.description: Select option object with value, label, and optional status or icon.

optionStatus.description: Status token used by option badges and chips.

selectOptions.description: Select options as an array of option objects or keyed map form.

validationRules.description: Laravel validation rules as a pipe-delimited string or string array.

field.description: Source field id to copy from

preset.description: Preset source definition for copying values from another field.

fieldTriggerCondition.description: Condition expression used by dynamic field trigger rules.

fieldTrigger.description: Trigger rule definition for conditional field behavior.

spanValue.description: Responsive grid span: named token or fraction alias; normalized to named form server-side.

showLabelOption.description: Label placement relative to the control: stacked (default when omitted for most fields), inline (label beside control), or none (visually hidden; still exposed to assistive tech).

fieldsetLabelString.description: Optional section title: adjacent fields with the same normalized label and variant are grouped together.

icon.description: Lucide icon key (kebab-case or snake_case), resolved via the menu icon registry.

variant.description: Visual style for the section: card (default), minimal and plain are lighter chrome; none hides the title visually (screen-reader legend only).

collapsed.description: When present, the section is collapsible: true starts collapsed, false starts expanded. Omit for a non-collapsible section. Cannot be combined with variant none (stripped server-side).

fieldsetObject.description: Section title, optional icon, optional layout variant, and optional collapsible behavior for grouped fields.

fieldsetInput.description: Plain string label or explicit title, optional icon, and optional layout variant.

fieldSelect.description: Select field definition with static or relation-backed options.

relation.description: Eloquent relation method for remote options; use type combobox + relation instead of obsolete type relation.

relation_name.description: Label column on related model for relation-options / chips

relation_value.description: Value column on related model (often id)

fieldCombobox.description: Combobox field definition with optional relation-backed options.

fileUploadMode.description: Persistence strategy for uploaded files: related records or URL(s) in model attributes. `image` matches URL persistence but shows image previews in the form UI. `file` matches URL persistence but shows a file-card preview (icon, name, size) instead of a bare filename row.

fileUploadPersistAs.description: How URL mode persists values when `multiple` is true.

disk.description: Laravel filesystem disk name, or the reserved token `media` (maps to config `flatpack.uploads.media_disk`). When omitted, uploads use `flatpack.uploads.file_disk`.

collection.description: Optional collection/group identifier stored in upload metadata.

editorUpload.description: Upload settings for rich-text and block-editor media insertion; stored URLs are embedded in editor JSON.

relation.description: Relation name used for relation mode persistence.

callback.description: When `mode: relation`, name of a public method on the entity model invoked with the list of upload metadata arrays (persist related records in application code).

target_column.description: Model attribute receiving URL(s) in url mode.

fieldFileUpload.description: File upload field definition supporting relation-backed attachments or URL persistence.

action.description: Built-in: `create` and `add` open a blank draft row in the row detail drawer (same UX path). Other values are custom and use host onToolbarAction when wired.

widget.description: Single-widget map keyed by widget id and resolved by widget runtime.

fieldWidget.description: Read-only widget field definition rendered inside forms.

actions.description: Same map shape as top-level form `actions` (action id → header action definition).

fieldToolbar.description: Toolbar row of header-style actions (publish, links, etc.). Not persisted as form values.

fieldRepeater.description: Repeating block of sub-fields persisted as an array of objects. Use `groups` for group mode, or for a single template use top-level `fields` (inline) or `form` (string path to a YAML fragment only).

fields.description: Inline item field map. Mutually exclusive with `form` (path string).

prompt.description: Label for the control that adds a new item. Default: Add new item.

itemsExpanded.description: When `displayMode` is accordion, whether items start expanded. Default: true.

titleFrom.description: Item attribute key used as the collapsed row title. Use boolean false with minItems and maxItems both 1 to omit the per-row title bar.

minItems.description: Minimum rows; may pre-render empty rows when not using groups (e.g. minItems: 1 shows one row).

groupKeyFrom.description: Attribute on each saved item that stores the selected group key. Default: _group.

showReorder.description: Show reorder / sort controls. Default: true.

fieldTableActions.description: Embedded table toolbar actions as keyed map or ordered array.

fieldTable.description: Embedded table field definition with columns, row behavior, and optional relation hydration.

columns.description: Same shapes as list.yaml columns: array of column definitions, or map of columnId -> definition. Embedded table columns may set `edit_form_field` (full form-field shape) to override row-drawer rendering.

actions.description: Toolbar buttons. If both `actions` and `toolbar` are set, `actions` is used.

toolbar.description: Alias for `actions` (same shape). Ignored when `actions` is present.

toolbar_actions.description: Legacy list-style key; same shape as `actions`. Used only when `actions` and `toolbar` are absent.

toolbarActions.description: Legacy camelCase key; same shape as `actions`. Lowest precedence among toolbar sources.

default_sort.description: Default local sort used when row table first renders.

pagination.description: Pagination visibility override: true always shows controls, false always hides controls.

showColumnsVisibility.description: Show or hide the column visibility dropdown in the table toolbar.

row_detail_drawer.description: When false, clicking a data row does not open the row detail drawer; toolbar `create` still uses the drawer for new rows (`add`/other may share that drawer when wired).

relation.description: Eloquent relation method name on the parent model; when present, table is relation-backed (hydration + sync).

model.description: Model class name for immediate row persistence from the embedded table drawer.

relation_value.description: Related model key attribute for RelationRow identity (default id).

limit.description: Max related rows to hydrate (capped also by config flatpack.forms).

table_relation_type.description: Eloquent relation class for this table field, usually derived from the parent form model. Authors may set this in YAML to override auto-detection.

embeddedTableColumnEditFormFieldDefiniti.description: Inline row-drawer edit field override for embedded table columns.

embeddedTableColumnDefinition.description: Embedded table column definition with optional edit field override.

oneOf.description: Pagination visibility override: true always shows controls, false always hides controls.

columns.description: Optional YAML column definitions. When present, take precedence over any columns returned by the widget provider at runtime.

showColumnsVisibility.description: Show or hide the column visibility dropdown in the widget table toolbar.

paginate.description: Model-backed only: rows per server page. Defaults to 5 when omitted. If `pagination` is an object with `per_page`, that value takes precedence.

showColumnsVisibility.description: Show or hide the column visibility dropdown in the widget table toolbar.

gridCardSlotMap.description: Optional card slot map for `type: grid` widgets. Keys reference column ids on the widget. When omitted, slots auto-derive from columns.

title.description: Column id used as the card title.

subtitle.description: Column id used as the card subtitle.

image.description: Column id whose value is rendered as the card media (URL or path).

badges.description: Column ids rendered as badge chips on the card.

body.description: Column ids rendered as label/value pairs in the card body.

footer_actions.description: Column id of an `actions` column rendered in the card footer.

gridMediaCardSlotMap.description: Card slot map for grid widgets that emphasize image/media columns. Currently matches `gridCardSlotMap`; may gain media-specific keys later.

title.description: Column id used as the card title.

subtitle.description: Column id used as the card subtitle.

image.description: Column id whose value is rendered as the card media (URL or path).

badges.description: Column ids rendered as badge chips on the card.

body.description: Column ids rendered as label/value pairs in the card body.

footer_actions.description: Column id of an `actions` column rendered in the card footer.

gridWidgetProviderBacked.description: Provider-backed grid widget: same options as `tableWidgetProviderBacked` but rendered as a responsive card grid.

columns.description: Optional YAML column definitions. When present, take precedence over any columns returned by the widget provider at runtime.

showColumnsVisibility.description: Show or hide the column visibility dropdown in the widget grid toolbar.

gridWidgetModelBacked.description: Model-backed grid widget: same options as `tableWidgetModelBacked` but rendered as a responsive card grid.

paginate.description: Model-backed only: cards per server page. Defaults to 6 when omitted. If `pagination` is an object with `per_page`, that value takes precedence.

showColumnsVisibility.description: Show or hide the column visibility dropdown in the widget grid toolbar.

provider.description: Key in config `flatpack.widget_providers` used to resolve runtime data.

color.description: Series stroke/fill: an `optionStatus` token (same as select option badges) or any CSS color string.

x_key.description: Optional data key for the X axis (dates or categories). Defaults to date.

mode.description: Chart render mode. Defaults to area when omitted.

variant.description: Area-only variant. area_stacked is the default when mode is area.

time_ranges.description: Optional range filters. When omitted, range controls are hidden and all points are shown.

provider.description: Key in config `flatpack.widget_providers` used to resolve runtime data.

data.description: Populated at runtime from the widget provider; omitted in YAML.

chartWidgetResolvedData.description: Shape returned from a WidgetPayload provider (merged into the widget as `data`; table widgets also merge `columns` from the provider onto the widget definition).

points.description: Time series or category rows; each point must include `chart.x_key` and series value keys.

widgetStatus.description: Card widget status token used by status badges.
